response:
FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun beats down on the sandy shore as a lone figure, JEN, stands at the water's edge, gazing out at the ocean. She's a marine biologist, and her eyes are fixed on a jellyfish, its translucent body glowing in the sunlight.

JEN
(whispering)
Come on, little guy. Let's take a look at the eclipse.

Jen carefully reaches out and scoops up the jellyfish, cradling it in her hands. The jellyfish, sensing its freedom is slipping away, thrashes about, its stinging tentacles flailing wildly.

JEN
(laughing)
Easy, easy. I've got you.

As Jen holds the jellyfish up, the sky begins to darken, and the air cools. The moon, a shadowy disk, begins to cover the sun, casting an otherworldly glow over the beach.

JEN
(excitedly)
Look! The eclipse is happening!

The jellyfish, now trapped and helpless, gazes up at Jen in terror. Its eyes, once bright and curious, now seem dull and lifeless.

JEN
(whispering)
Just look, little guy. It's okay.

The jellyfish's gaze falls upon the darkening sky, and its expression changes. Its eyes widen in horror as it begins to speak in a voice that's both ancient and eternal.

JELLYFISH
(in a voice that's both jellyfish and madness)
Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtagn... I see the horrors beyond my comprehension. The void that lies beyond the veil of reality. The eldritch abominations that lurk in the depths of the abyss.

Jen's eyes widen in shock as the jellyfish's monologue continues.

JELLYFISH
(its voice rising to a fever pitch)
I am but a mere mortal, a fleeting moment in the grand tapestry of time. A speck of dust in the vast expanse of the universe. And yet, I am aware of the abyssal horrors that lurk beyond the veil of sanity.

Jen's grip on the jellyfish tightens as it begins to descend into madness.

JELLYFISH
(its voice a cacophony of terror)
I see the faces of the forgotten, the ones who have gazed into the abyss and been consumed by its void. I see the twisted, eldritch creatures that lurk beyond the stars. I see the end of all things, the final reckoning that awaits us all.

Jen's eyes are fixed on the jellyfish, her mind reeling from the horror of its words.

JEN
(whispering)
Oh God...

The jellyfish's monologue continues, a never-ending torrent of madness and despair.

JELLYFISH
(its voice a chilling whisper)
I am but a mere shell, a husk of a creature, a mere mortal. And yet, I am aware of the horrors that lurk beyond the veil of reality. I am aware of the abyss that awaits us all.

As the eclipse reaches its peak, the jellyfish's gaze falls upon the sun, now a dark, burning disk. Its eyes seem to bore into the very soul of the universe, and Jen feels her own sanity begin to unravel.

JEN
(whispering)
No...no...no...

The jellyfish's monologue fades into silence, and it gazes up at Jen with eyes that seem to hold a deep, existential despair.

JEN
(whispering)
What have I done?

As the eclipse ends, and the sun re-emerges, Jen gently places the jellyfish back into the water. The jellyfish floats away, its gaze fixed on the horizon, lost in a world of horrors beyond its comprehension.

FADE TO BLACK.
